snippet.title: Hotel Architect | 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Check-in opens for Hotel Architect on May 14th! 

Step into the shoes of a hotel owner as you design, build, and manage a live operation that reacts to your choices, requires meticulous planning, and demands attention to detail! 

Hotel Architect is the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game which gives you complete creative freedom... but not without consequences.

Out Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1602000/Hotel_Architect/
Follow Wired: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/WIRED
